As for understanding a World Champion profile, let me explain.

"Current WRs" means the number of WRs you have at the moment on all maps that have been present in TT at least once.

"Total WRs" means the total number of WRs you have had since the beginning of the TT on MKT. This means that if you had a WR on Toad Circuit when the map went out for the first time but when the map came back a second time someone beat you, then you lose your WR and the counter in "Current WRs" decreases BUT your counter in Total does not change, because once upon a time you had the WR on this circuit.

"Unique WRs" means the unique number of tracks on which you have a WR. Let's say Sunset Wilds Reverse came out 2x in TT, if you had the WR on the first time and you fought when the track came out the 2nd time and you still had the WR on the 2nd time, then the WR will only be counted once in "Unique WRs" and 2x in "Total WRs".

For people who have already done TT on old MKs, it is the same logic as what is written on the Mario Kart WRs site: https://mkwrs.com/
